notes.title: Character Selection Screen
notes.content:
New Features:
Enhanced Character Selection Screen:

Players can now select characters more quickly and easily, with each character's traits and abilities showcased through animations.
Dynamic backgrounds have been added to the character selection screen. Different planetary landscapes are displayed with visual effects based on the chosen character.

notes.title: Version 0.0.2!
notes.content:
We're releasing Galacticverse Version 0.0.2 this week, featuring over 7 new shooter game modes, brand-new weapons, and improved game mechanics for a more stable experience! 🔥

🔸Our upcoming updates aim to take the shooter mode from its MVP stage to a fully enhanced state through continuous improvements.
